758:t_1:664.en:
$$シエロ$$
「My only regret is that I didn't get to see you as a bride.」

758:t_1:665.en:
$$メール$$
「Then there's nothing to worry about! The wedding is still to come!」

758:t_1:667.en:
$$メール$$
「$$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$, $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$, and $c! Let's invite lots of guests from parallel worlds too!」

758:t_1:668.en:
$$メール$$
「I'm the bride of the hyperdimensional world! I'm so happy!」

758:t_1:670.en:
$$シエロ$$
「You're forgetting to smile, $$ランド$$!」

758:t_1:671.en:
$$ランド$$
「Fine, I'll go all out! I'll steel myself too!!」

758:t_1:673.en:
$$ランド$$
「Now that that's decided, let's do it! First, I'll work flat out to save up for the wedding!」

758:t_1:674.en:
$$ランド$$
「Then I'll have a good beer! Whatever happens to the world, that won't change!」

758:t_1:675.en:
$$ランド$$
(That's how it is, $$ガンレオン$$. I'm counting on you from here on too, partner.)

758:t_1:679.en:
$$パーラ$$
「Let's do it! We're the stars of this new world!」

758:t_1:680.en:
$$キッド$$
「This junk shop, '$$フリーデン$$,' is going to be the star?」

758:t_1:681.en:
$$パーラ$$
「The fighting is over now. Let's make it big with honest business from here on.」

758:t_1:682.en:
$$シンゴ$$
「$$パーラ$$ is right. We've stopped being $$バルチャー$$s now too.」

758:t_1:684.en:
$$ウィッツ$$
「I'd trust $$サラ$$ with it, but you...」

758:t_1:685.en:
$$エニル$$
「Don't say that. $$サラ$$ is going back to work for the new government with $$ジャミル$$.」

758:t_1:686.en:
$$サラ$$
「Take care, everyone. I'm rooting for you in your new jobs.」

758:t_1:687.en:
$$ロアビィ$$
「You too. If anything happens, get in touch with us.」

758:t_1:688.en:
$$ジャミル$$
「Yes... I'll count on you when that happens.」

758:t_1:689.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Everyone's going their own way.」

758:t_1:691.en:
$$ガロード$$
「But no matter what happens, I'll be with you, $$ティファ$$.」

758:t_1:693.en:
$$テクス$$
「The coffee's just ready. Let's toast our new beginnings with it.」

758:t_1:694.en:
$$ジャミル$$
「Then may happiness fill our futures and the world's...!」

758:t_1:695.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Let's do our best, everyone!」

758:t_1:696.en:
$$ガロード$$
(And someday... I'll travel across parallel worlds to see everyone... Together with $$ティファ$$!)

758:t_1:700.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「...Then, $$キエル$$... I'm entrusting the $$ムーンレィス$$ to you.」

758:t_1:701.en:
$$キエル$$
「I don't know how much I'll be able to do, but I'll give my all to the role you've entrusted to me, $$ディアナ$$.」

758:t_1:702.en:
$$キエル$$
「And I'll peacefully fulfill the $$ムーンレィス$$'s long-cherished wish to return to Earth.」

758:t_1:703.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「Thank you, $$キエル$$. You are the queen who will create a new age.」

758:t_1:704.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「Captain $$ハリー$$, please take care of the new Moon Queen.」

758:t_1:705.en:
$$ハリー$$
「I will, even at the cost of my life.」

758:t_1:706.en:
$$メシェー$$
「You're going to be the Moon Queen, $$キエル$$...」

758:t_1:708.en:
$$メシェー$$
「But what surprises me is that rich boy $$グエン$$. After everything he did, he's neatly landed the position of lord of $$イングレッサ$$.」

758:t_1:710.en:
$$メシェー$$
「Well... $$ソシエ$$... I know it hurts, but...」

758:t_1:714.en:
$$ソシエ$$
「It's all right, $$ディアナ$$. $$ロラン$$ chose to go with you.」

758:t_1:716.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「But, $$ソシエ$$... $$ロラン$$ will be coming back to you soon.」

758:t_1:718.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「I asked $$ロラン$$ to spend the time with me until I go to sleep.」

758:t_1:719.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「After that, $$ロラン$$ will return to you.」

758:t_1:723.en:
$$ソシエ$$
「But I'll... be waiting, always. So...」

758:t_1:726.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「I'm counting on you, $$ロラン・セアック$$.」

758:t_1:727.en:
$$ロラン$$
(I'll be going, Miss. But... the place I'll return to is by your side...)

758:t_1:728.en:
$$ロラン$$
(And someday... when the people of Earth and the Moon are united, let's go see everyone too...)

758:t_1:732.en:
$$ベベル$$
「...Long ago, when the sun in the sky was dying, people had to choose whether to board ships that traveled the stars or transform themselves into $$クジライカ$$.」

758:t_1:735.en:
$$ベベル$$
「While those two branches of humanity kept fighting even after abandoning their home, this planet's civilization died out...」

758:t_1:736.en:
$$ベベル$$
「But people who believed in hope revived this planet and its oceans...」

758:t_1:737.en:
$$ベベル$$
「And we survived above the waves, while the $$クジライカ$$ survived beneath the sea.」

758:t_1:738.en:
$$メルティ$$
「Hey, $$ベベル$$... What subject is this lesson?」

758:t_1:739.en:
$$ベベル$$
「Dr. $$オルダム$$ calls it archaeology.」

758:t_1:740.en:
$$ベベル$$
「By learning where we came from, we can think about where we're going... He says it's a very important field for our future.」

758:t_1:741.en:
$$サーヤ$$
「I don't really understand it, but learning about the past is kind of fun.」

758:t_1:742.en:
$$ベベル$$
「We should unravel more and more mysteries now. $$ガルガンティア$$ has a brave explorer, after all.」

758:t_1:743.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「$$レド$$... It seems they're calling for you.」

758:t_1:745.en:
$$ベベル$$
「Yes. We've learned all sorts of things thanks to the old records you've salvaged from the ruins, $$レド$$.」

758:t_1:746.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Thanks for your hard work today, $$レド$$. Did you find anything?」

758:t_1:747.en:
$$レド$$
「I found some storage media. In this condition, $$ピニオン$$ should be able to analyze it.」

758:t_1:748.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「I don't get you. If you used that tin can, it'd be much easier to do all sorts of things.」

758:t_1:749.en:
$$レド$$
「I can't rely on $$チェインバー#pilot$$ forever. I want to be able to live by my own strength.」

758:t_1:750.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「This unit respects Ensign $$レド$$'s decision. This unit also has its own duties.」

758:t_1:751.en:
$$レド$$
「You seem to have gotten used to unloading cargo too.」

758:t_1:752.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Nothing is impossible for this unit.」
